Innodata AI Hackathon 2026 · New Delhi Finale

Build AI. Solve Real Challenges. Make Your Mark.

Tackle real-world AI engineering challenges solo or in teams (1–4) and compete for a ₹10 lakh prize pool at the Grand Finale in New Delhi.

₹10L
Prize Pool
Free
Registration
1–4
Team Size
6 Dec
Deadline

Section 02 · Challenges

Two Challenges. Endless Possibilities.

Challenge 01

Coding Task Factory

Build a system that creates, tests, and validates real-world coding challenges to evaluate AI's coding capabilities.

View Full Problem Statement

Your challenge is to build a reusable system that creates realistic software development tasks, complete with requirements, working reference solutions, and automated tests.

What You'll Build
  • ✓A pipeline that generates coding tasks from an existing codebase.
  • ✓Reference implementations and tests to validate each task.
  • ✓Evidence that your system produces different, reliable, and repeatable challenges.
Example: Imagine an AI-generated task that asks a shopping app to add discount codes. Your system should generate the requirements, implement the feature, and test whether it works correctly.

Ideal for: Developers, software engineers, coding enthusiasts, and automation builders.

Challenge 02

Visual Task Factory

Develop a system that generates visual tasks and verifies how accurately AI understands images.

View Full Problem Statement

AI models can describe pictures, read charts, and answer visual questions — but how accurately do they understand what they're seeing? Create a system that generates visual tasks and uses independently verified answers to evaluate AI models.

What You'll Build
  • ✓A pipeline that generates synthetic images and visual questions.
  • ✓Verified answers to evaluate model responses.
  • ✓A testing framework that reveals where multimodal AI succeeds or struggles.
Example: Generate a bar chart with known values, ask an AI model to identify the tallest bar, and automatically verify whether its answer is correct.

Ideal for: AI/ML enthusiasts, computer vision learners, data scientists, and multimodal AI builders.
